spec.title: Unexpected errors · ${category} · tests: ${test_errors}
spec.description: All unexpected errors are included by default. Expected wallet declines remain in session timelines. Category is reported impact or a diagnostic category, not proof of harmlessness; absent impact is Unclassified. Test marks known controlled errors. Groups use type + normalized heading, per release/category/test status. Counts are observations, not unique incidents. First/last seen and affected sessions apply to the selected range. Missing session IDs are not counted. Assignment and resolution are not tracked.
